title: 8-Channel SSVEP EEG Dataset with Artifact Trials
description: An 8-channel EEG dataset comprising steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) recordings from 6 participants performing attention tasks at three stimulation frequencies (2 Hz, 4 Hz, 8 Hz). The dataset includes both artifact-free trials with minimal movement and trials with voluntary head, neck, and eye movements, enabling investigation of SSVEP robustness under naturalistic conditions.
methods_description: Participants performed SSVEP tasks with visual stimulation at three frequencies (2 Hz, 4 Hz, 8 Hz). For each frequency, participants completed 3 trials while remaining static to minimize artifacts and 3 trials while making voluntary head/neck and eye movements. EEG was recorded using an 8-channel system.
